mapper.select: SELECT s.id AS spot_id, s.type AS type, s.name AS name, s.status AS status, ST_Latitude(s.location) AS lat, ST_Longitude(s.location) AS lng, s.park_warning AS park_warning, b.reporter_id AS reporter_id, m.nickname AS reporter_nickname, COALESCE(rc.report_count, 0) AS report_count, COALESCE(rc.illegal_area_count, 0) AS illegal_area_count, COALESCE(rc.closed_count, 0) AS closed_count, COALESCE(rc.false_info_count, 0) AS false_info_count, s.updated_at AS status_changed_at FROM spot s LEFT JOIN bakji_detail b ON b.spot_id = s.id LEFT JOIN member m ON m.id = b.reporter_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.spot_id AS spot_id, COUNT(*) AS report_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'ILLEGAL_AREA' THEN 1 END) AS illegal_area_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS closed_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN r.reason = 'FALSE_INFO' THEN 1 END) AS false_info_count FROM bakji_report r JOIN spot target ON target.id = r.spot_id WHERE r.reviewed_at IS NULL AND target.status = #{status} GROUP BY r.spot_id ) rc ON rc.spot_id = s.id WHERE s.status = #{status} ORDER BY s.updated_at ASC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
